title: Every field of a difference result needs a test with a non-empty difference, both ways
rule: When a function compares two things and returns added/removed (gained/lost) lists or changed flags, give each field a test pair where that field is non-empty, assert its exact value, and run the same pair the other way round so added and removed swap. A test of identical inputs only proves the fields are empty, which an always-empty or swapped implementation also passes. Derive the pair from a fixture (rename one tag, drop one record) when the corpus has no natural pair.
rationale: E56.2 (#662): compare_copies set features_added/removed and axes_added/removed, but the only test that read them compared a file with itself, so emptying or swapping them left every test green.
